messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: reserved-pool 'dedicated-east-1-resv' util=100% queue=420 growth=+180/min. Autoscaler failing to add nodes (error: quota_exceeded/scale_timeout). Affected tenants with reservations: AcmeCorp(80% of queue), GreenfieldPay(10%). Paging ops_oncall and infra team. See /incidents/2987654321 for context.
ops_oncall: ack. paging raj and sylvia. need quick assessment — is this noisy-tenant or global capacity? :eyes:
raj: on it. linking the queue dashboard — https://dash/redwood/pools/dedicated-east-1-resv/queues. I'm seeing sustained queue latency > 12s, pending tokens growing. Metrics: avg req_size ~ 180 tokens.
sylvia: joining. checking autoscaler logs now. running: `kubectl logs autoscaler-dedicated-east-1 -n redwood-serving --since=10m`
dave: FYI AcmeCorp support just DM'd escalations, they see 503s on inference endpoints. asked for ETA.
raj: autoscaler logs show repeated failures: `scale_request rejected: quotaExceeded for project: enterprise-accounts` followed by `scale_timeout: requested nodes not provisioned within 60s` snippet: ```2026-03-15T03:12:05Z autoscaler INFO request nodes=10 reason=queue_growth
2026-03-15T03:12:07Z autoscaler ERROR provisioner: quotaExceeded project=redwood-acme
2026-03-15T03:12:45Z autoscaler WARN scale_timeout nodes_pending=8
```
sylvia: also seeing a pattern of one tenant using a lot of reserved GPU sessions with long-lived beam-search jobs. looks like noisy neighbor. their reservation is valid but traffic spiky and not capping concurrency.
ops_oncall: can we throttle per-reservation concurrency temporarily? runbook suggests `reservation:set-concurrency --tenant AcmeCorp --limit 4` as emergency.
raj: attempting throttle now. running command: ```redwoodctl reservation update --tenant AcmeCorp --concurrency-limit 4 --grace-period 30s```
raj: command returned 202 accepted. will monitor queue for 30s.
emma: sending note to Acme on support channel: "We're seeing high reserved usage and applying a temporary concurrency cap to stabilize the pool. We'll follow up with mitigation plan and timeline."
maria: can we preempt non-reserved ephemeral jobs to free GPUs? what are eviction policies for dedicated-resv?
sylvia: yes we can preempt best-effort jobs. issuing `evict --pool dedicated-east-1-resv --policy best-effort` to free up 6 GPUs. doing now.
sylvia: eviction started. watchers: some batch jobs terminated, freeing resources.
ops_oncall: autoscaler still reporting quota errors when trying to request additional capacity. looks like we've hit cloud quota for GPUs in this region. raising with infra: paging cloud-quotas@internal.
dave: Acme is reporting partial success but still ~20% of their requests 503ing. we should consider routing heavy requests to a secondary model variant (cpu-optimized or quantized) while capacity recovers. product ok with temporary model fallback?
raj: proposing immediate fallback rule: for AcmeCorp route high-cost model -> `redwood/model:compress-v2` (quantized) for 30m. will push canary route.
raj: pushed route rule: `if tenant==AcmeCorp && queue_len>50 -> model=compress-v2` — applied. monitoring effects.
ops_oncall: good. queue for Acme fell from 320 to 95 in 3m after throttle + eviction + fallback. overall pool util down to 92%. still above target but improving.
sylvia: autoscaler: after quota appeal, cloud team approved 4 GPUs, but provisioning delayed. once those land we should revert throttles. cloud-quotas update pinned in #eng-infra.
emma: documenting customer impact: AcmeCorp experiencing elevated errors for ~20m window, degraded latency for 40m. ticket #INC-2026-2987 created and linked to their account. cc account execs.
maria: next steps for follow-up: 1) postmortem to investigate client's long-lived sessions and reservation sizing, 2) improve autoscaler retry/backoff for quota_exceeded, 3) add alert to detect reservation-level skew earlier.
ops_oncall: agreed. I'll do handoff to second oncall (emma) in 15m with checklist: current mitigations (concurrency cap, fallback rule, evictions), outstanding actions (cloud provisioning, revert plan). Emma — you're up for 02:30-10:30 shift.
emma: ack, taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring until autoscaler reports pool util < 75% for 10m. adding note to the thread: `Handoff: ops_oncall -> emma at 03:45 UTC`
incident-bot: Incident timeline appended to /incidents/logs/2987654321. Oncall page acknowledged by emma. :white_check_mark:
ops_oncall: closing active paging. if anything spikes ping @emma or reopen channel. great job team, will follow up with a blameless postmortem doc and runbook updates. :tada:
